issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.title: ponta.content-lump.net: guidance for a wall.php exception under Resort Island anti-adblock terms
issue.body:
### Service and affected page

Official public entry: https://play.ponta.jp/resort/index.html

Observed affected hostname and path: `ponta.content-lump.net/wall.php`

The browser's visible address omits the scheme, so an HTTPS-only affected URL is not asserted. Authentication and tracking query parameters are omitted.

### Observed policy and purpose

On 13 October 2026, the Ponta Resort Island how-to page explicitly prohibited communication manipulation, including AdBlock and similar advertisement blockers. It also prohibits tools that overload the server or give an unfair gameplay advantage.

The service requires entry through the Ponta PLAY top page rather than bookmarked internal pages. The normal entry route used was Ponta PLAY → Resort Island → Play now, using an existing signed-in account.

I want to respect the service's advertisement requirements with a page-scoped exception while retaining filtering on unrelated websites. This is a request for compatibility guidance, not a claim that a game is broken or that AdGuard caused a confirmed failure.

### Actual rule and verification

Saved and enabled document exception:

`@@||ponta.content-lump.net/wall.php$document`

The rule is domain-anchored to the wall.php route and works across schemes. Its enabled checkbox and the User Rules master switch were read back after saving. Global protection remained enabled.

No game was started as a controlled retest of this new rule. No blocked gameplay, failed reward, successful advertisement completion, or new reward is established by this observation. No global-protection-OFF comparison was performed.

### Requested guidance

Could you advise whether this wall.php document exception is appropriate for the published anti-adblock policy, or whether a different narrowly scoped compatibility rule is required? Any additional rule should be based on the actual game or advertisement request that needs it, without disabling filtering on unrelated browsing.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed public filters, partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Regional filter observation | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter-update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified |
| Global protection | Enabled |

### Limitations and privacy

A responsible upstream filter and AdGuard causality have not been isolated. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing are unverified. No duplicate check was completed for this specific guidance request.

The policy text and rule readback were retained locally. No screenshots, media, account values, account/device identifiers, credentials, private query parameters, or private custom-filter contents are included or uploaded.

issue.title: ponta.abstractpainting.work: Paw bonus video remains loading (path-scoped exception; cause unconfirmed)
issue.body:
### Issue URL (website or app does not work properly)

https://ponta.abstractpainting.work/sp/sp-dog/movie.php

This is the bonus video for ポンタとお手できるかな, reached from Ponta PLAY. Authentication and tracking query parameters are omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, the ordinary illustration-viewing game worked, but its bonus-video page remained on a loading animation after 60 seconds. No playable advertisement or completion control appeared in that observation.

The game's index rules prohibit ad blockers. This is relevant context, but it does not prove that AdGuard caused this particular loading failure. I want to allow the advertisements required by this specific bonus while keeping filtering on unrelated websites enabled.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose ポンタとお手できるかな and use its normal illustration-viewing flow until the bonus-video option appears.
3. Tap the observed “Watch the video” control.
4. Observe the loading animation at the public movie.php route above; in the baseline test it persisted for 60 seconds.
5. Add and enable the exact document exception below, then return with browser Back and open “Watch the video” again through the normal game flow. No reload or timer manipulation was used.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Exact saved and enabled rule: `@@|https://ponta.abstractpainting.work/sp/sp-dog/movie.php$document`
- The fresh retest still showed the loading animation after at least 60 seconds with this exact exception enabled.
- Returning with browser Back reached the ordinary game’s receipt page; the bonus video had not completed.
- Global protection remained enabled. No global-protection-OFF comparison was performed.
- No bonus completion or reward credit is claimed.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after the path-specific change |

### Comparison and limitations

AdGuard causality and a responsible upstream filter have not been isolated. A publisher/ad-provider availability issue is also possible. Product/browser currency, filter-update timing, and the effect of a global-disable comparison are not claimed.

The video remained loading after at least 60 seconds under the narrow exception. Please investigate whether a narrowly scoped compatibility rule is appropriate; do not treat the successful ordinary-game flow as proof of bonus-video compatibility.

### Screenshot description and privacy

Local baseline captures show a loading animation on movie.php, including a capture after 60 seconds. The timed scoped retest also shows the loading animation after at least 60 seconds. The rule editor readback confirms the movie.php exception is enabled. No screenshots or media content have been uploaded or attached. Account values, identifiers, credentials, and private URL queries are omitted.

- https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/

These are the Ponta PLAY kanji and four-character idiom quizzes. Account-specific query parameters have been omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, both pages displayed this gate instead of the quiz:

> This content cannot be accessed if AdBlock is enabled. Please disable AdBlock and try accessing it again.

I want to allow the advertisements on these particular games while keeping filtering enabled for unrelated websites.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose Pontaの漢字テスト or Pontaの四字熟語クイズ.
3. Observe the gate above before reaching the game.
4. Apply the exact site/path exception below and reopen the same game through the content list.
5. Compare the visible result with the baseline.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Kanji rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document`
- Idiom rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document`
- Kanji after fresh navigation: rules and quiz load; question/answer flow works.
- Idiom after fresh navigation to its actual route: introduction and start route load; the AdBlock gate is gone.
- Kanji game access is restored with the scoped exception. The responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.
- Idiom introduction/start access is restored. Completed idiom play or reward credit is not asserted.
- Global protection remains enabled; both exception rules listed above were saved and read back enabled.
- Specific responsible upstream filter: not isolated.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after these path-specific changes |

### Comparison and limitations

Global AdGuard protection was not disabled for a comparison. This comparison used the two path-specific exceptions listed above. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing have not been independently verified. The public filter names are the visible readbacks, not a complete private configuration export.

### Related report

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/52566 was resolved in March 2020 for /quiz/ponta/. This report concerns the currently reproduced /kanji/ponta/ and /yojijukugo/ponta/ routes.

### Screenshot description

The saved baseline captures show the quoted AdBlock gate on each game landing page. Fresh retest captures show accessible kanji quiz and actual idiom introduction/start routes. No screenshot attachment has been uploaded. The visible gate and reproduction steps are described above; account-specific information is omitted.


Could you investigate a narrowly scoped compatibility fix for these two quiz paths? The workaround restores access while global protection stays enabled; the responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.

========================================================================

labels.name: A: In progress

issue.body:
### Issue URL (AdGuard gets detected / website unavailable)

- https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/
- https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/

These are the Ponta PLAY kanji and four-character idiom quizzes. Account-specific query parameters have been omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, both pages displayed this gate instead of the quiz:

> This content cannot be accessed if AdBlock is enabled. Please disable AdBlock and try accessing it again.

I want to allow the advertisements on these particular games while keeping filtering enabled for unrelated websites.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose Pontaの漢字テスト or Pontaの四字熟語クイズ.
3. Observe the gate above before reaching the game.
4. Apply the exact site/path exception below and reopen the same game through the content list.
5. Compare the visible result with the baseline.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Kanji rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document`
- Idiom rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document`
- Kanji after fresh navigation: rules and quiz load; question/answer flow works.
- Idiom after fresh navigation to its actual route: introduction and start route load; the AdBlock gate is gone.
- Kanji game access is restored with the scoped exception. The responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.
- Idiom introduction/start access is restored. Completed idiom play or reward credit is not asserted.
- Global protection remains enabled; both exception rules listed above were saved and read back enabled.
- Specific responsible upstream filter: not isolated.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after these path-specific changes |

### Comparison and limitations

Global AdGuard protection was not disabled for a comparison. This comparison used the two path-specific exceptions listed above. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing have not been independently verified. The public filter names are the visible readbacks, not a complete private configuration export.

### Related report

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/52566 was resolved in March 2020 for /quiz/ponta/. This report concerns the currently reproduced /kanji/ponta/ and /yojijukugo/ponta/ routes.

### Screenshot description

The saved baseline captures show the quoted AdBlock gate on each game landing page. Fresh retest captures show accessible kanji quiz and actual idiom introduction/start routes. No screenshot attachment has been uploaded. The visible gate and reproduction steps are described above; account-specific information is omitted.


Could you investigate a narrowly scoped compatibility fix for these two quiz paths? The workaround restores access while global protection stays enabled; the responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.

========================================================================

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
### Issue URL (AdGuard gets detected / website unavailable)

- https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/
- https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/

These are the Ponta PLAY kanji and four-character idiom quizzes. Account-specific query parameters have been omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, both pages displayed this gate instead of the quiz:

> This content cannot be accessed if AdBlock is enabled. Please disable AdBlock and try accessing it again.

I want to allow the advertisements on these particular games while keeping filtering enabled for unrelated websites.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose Pontaの漢字テスト or Pontaの四字熟語クイズ.
3. Observe the gate above before reaching the game.
4. Apply the exact site/path exception below and reopen the same game through the content list.
5. Compare the visible result with the baseline.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Kanji rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document`
- Idiom rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document`
- Kanji after fresh navigation: rules and quiz load; question/answer flow works.
- Idiom after fresh navigation to its actual route: introduction and start route load; the AdBlock gate is gone.
- Kanji game access is restored with the scoped exception. The responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.
- Idiom introduction/start access is restored. Completed idiom play or reward credit is not asserted.
- Global protection remains enabled; both exception rules listed above were saved and read back enabled.
- Specific responsible upstream filter: not isolated.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after these path-specific changes |

### Comparison and limitations

Global AdGuard protection was not disabled for a comparison. This comparison used the two path-specific exceptions listed above. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing have not been independently verified. The public filter names are the visible readbacks, not a complete private configuration export.

### Related report

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/52566 was resolved in March 2020 for /quiz/ponta/. This report concerns the currently reproduced /kanji/ponta/ and /yojijukugo/ponta/ routes.

### Screenshot description

The saved baseline captures show the quoted AdBlock gate on each game landing page. Fresh retest captures show accessible kanji quiz and actual idiom introduction/start routes. No screenshot attachment has been uploaded. The visible gate and reproduction steps are described above; account-specific information is omitted.


Could you investigate a narrowly scoped compatibility fix for these two quiz paths? The workaround restores access while global protection stays enabled; the responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.

========================================================================

issue.title: ponta.content-lump.net: guidance for a wall.php exception under Resort Island anti-adblock terms
issue.body:
### Service and affected page

Official public entry: https://play.ponta.jp/resort/index.html

Observed affected hostname and path: `ponta.content-lump.net/wall.php`

The browser's visible address omits the scheme, so an HTTPS-only affected URL is not asserted. Authentication and tracking query parameters are omitted.

### Observed policy and purpose

On 13 October 2026, the Ponta Resort Island how-to page explicitly prohibited communication manipulation, including AdBlock and similar advertisement blockers. It also prohibits tools that overload the server or give an unfair gameplay advantage.

The service requires entry through the Ponta PLAY top page rather than bookmarked internal pages. The normal entry route used was Ponta PLAY → Resort Island → Play now, using an existing signed-in account.

I want to respect the service's advertisement requirements with a page-scoped exception while retaining filtering on unrelated websites. This is a request for compatibility guidance, not a claim that a game is broken or that AdGuard caused a confirmed failure.

### Actual rule and verification

Saved and enabled document exception:

`@@||ponta.content-lump.net/wall.php$document`

The rule is domain-anchored to the wall.php route and works across schemes. Its enabled checkbox and the User Rules master switch were read back after saving. Global protection remained enabled.

No game was started as a controlled retest of this new rule. No blocked gameplay, failed reward, successful advertisement completion, or new reward is established by this observation. No global-protection-OFF comparison was performed.

### Requested guidance

Could you advise whether this wall.php document exception is appropriate for the published anti-adblock policy, or whether a different narrowly scoped compatibility rule is required? Any additional rule should be based on the actual game or advertisement request that needs it, without disabling filtering on unrelated browsing.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed public filters, partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Regional filter observation | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter-update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified |
| Global protection | Enabled |

### Limitations and privacy

A responsible upstream filter and AdGuard causality have not been isolated. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing are unverified. No duplicate check was completed for this specific guidance request.

The policy text and rule readback were retained locally. No screenshots, media, account values, account/device identifiers, credentials, private query parameters, or private custom-filter contents are included or uploaded.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
### Issue URL (AdGuard gets detected / website unavailable)

- https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/
- https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/

These are the Ponta PLAY kanji and four-character idiom quizzes. Account-specific query parameters have been omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, both pages displayed this gate instead of the quiz:

> This content cannot be accessed if AdBlock is enabled. Please disable AdBlock and try accessing it again.

I want to allow the advertisements on these particular games while keeping filtering enabled for unrelated websites.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose Pontaの漢字テスト or Pontaの四字熟語クイズ.
3. Observe the gate above before reaching the game.
4. Apply the exact site/path exception below and reopen the same game through the content list.
5. Compare the visible result with the baseline.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Kanji rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document`
- Idiom rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document`
- Kanji after fresh navigation: rules and quiz load; question/answer flow works.
- Idiom after fresh navigation to its actual route: introduction and start route load; the AdBlock gate is gone.
- Kanji game access is restored with the scoped exception. The responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.
- Idiom introduction/start access is restored. Completed idiom play or reward credit is not asserted.
- Global protection remains enabled; both exception rules listed above were saved and read back enabled.
- Specific responsible upstream filter: not isolated.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after these path-specific changes |

### Comparison and limitations

Global AdGuard protection was not disabled for a comparison. This comparison used the two path-specific exceptions listed above. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing have not been independently verified. The public filter names are the visible readbacks, not a complete private configuration export.

### Related report

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/52566 was resolved in March 2020 for /quiz/ponta/. This report concerns the currently reproduced /kanji/ponta/ and /yojijukugo/ponta/ routes.

### Screenshot description

The saved baseline captures show the quoted AdBlock gate on each game landing page. Fresh retest captures show accessible kanji quiz and actual idiom introduction/start routes. No screenshot attachment has been uploaded. The visible gate and reproduction steps are described above; account-specific information is omitted.


Could you investigate a narrowly scoped compatibility fix for these two quiz paths? The workaround restores access while global protection stays enabled; the responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.

========================================================================

issue.body:
### Issue URL (website or app does not work properly)

https://ponta.abstractpainting.work/sp/sp-dog/movie.php

This is the bonus video for ポンタとお手できるかな, reached from Ponta PLAY. Authentication and tracking query parameters are omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, the ordinary illustration-viewing game worked, but its bonus-video page remained on a loading animation after 60 seconds. No playable advertisement or completion control appeared in that observation.

The game's index rules prohibit ad blockers. This is relevant context, but it does not prove that AdGuard caused this particular loading failure. I want to allow the advertisements required by this specific bonus while keeping filtering on unrelated websites enabled.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose ポンタとお手できるかな and use its normal illustration-viewing flow until the bonus-video option appears.
3. Tap the observed “Watch the video” control.
4. Observe the loading animation at the public movie.php route above; in the baseline test it persisted for 60 seconds.
5. Add and enable the exact document exception below, then return with browser Back and open “Watch the video” again through the normal game flow. No reload or timer manipulation was used.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Exact saved and enabled rule: `@@|https://ponta.abstractpainting.work/sp/sp-dog/movie.php$document`
- The fresh retest still showed the loading animation after at least 60 seconds with this exact exception enabled.
- Returning with browser Back reached the ordinary game’s receipt page; the bonus video had not completed.
- Global protection remained enabled. No global-protection-OFF comparison was performed.
- No bonus completion or reward credit is claimed.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after the path-specific change |

### Comparison and limitations

AdGuard causality and a responsible upstream filter have not been isolated. A publisher/ad-provider availability issue is also possible. Product/browser currency, filter-update timing, and the effect of a global-disable comparison are not claimed.

The video remained loading after at least 60 seconds under the narrow exception. Please investigate whether a narrowly scoped compatibility rule is appropriate; do not treat the successful ordinary-game flow as proof of bonus-video compatibility.

### Screenshot description and privacy

Local baseline captures show a loading animation on movie.php, including a capture after 60 seconds. The timed scoped retest also shows the loading animation after at least 60 seconds. The rule editor readback confirms the movie.php exception is enabled. No screenshots or media content have been uploaded or attached. Account values, identifiers, credentials, and private URL queries are omitted.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.title: ad-contents.jp: Ponta kanji and idiom quiz anti-adblock gates (path-scoped workaround)

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Issue URL (AdGuard gets detected / website unavailable)

- https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/
- https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/

These are the Ponta PLAY kanji and four-character idiom quizzes. Account-specific query parameters have been omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, both pages displayed this gate instead of the quiz:

> This content cannot be accessed if AdBlock is enabled. Please disable AdBlock and try accessing it again.

I want to allow the advertisements on these particular games while keeping filtering enabled for unrelated websites.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose Pontaの漢字テスト or Pontaの四字熟語クイズ.
3. Observe the gate above before reaching the game.
4. Apply the exact site/path exception below and reopen the same game through the content list.
5. Compare the visible result with the baseline.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Kanji rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document`
- Idiom rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document`
- Kanji after fresh navigation: rules and quiz load; question/answer flow works.
- Idiom after fresh navigation to its actual route: introduction and start route load; the AdBlock gate is gone.
- Kanji game access is restored with the scoped exception. The responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.
- Idiom introduction/start access is restored. Completed idiom play or reward credit is not asserted.
- Global protection remains enabled; both exception rules listed above were saved and read back enabled.
- Specific responsible upstream filter: not isolated.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after these path-specific changes |

### Comparison and limitations

Global AdGuard protection was not disabled for a comparison. This comparison used the two path-specific exceptions listed above. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing have not been independently verified. The public filter names are the visible readbacks, not a complete private configuration export.

### Related report

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/52566 was resolved in March 2020 for /quiz/ponta/. This report concerns the currently reproduced /kanji/ponta/ and /yojijukugo/ponta/ routes.

### Screenshot description

The saved baseline captures show the quoted AdBlock gate on each game landing page. Fresh retest captures show accessible kanji quiz and actual idiom introduction/start routes. No screenshot attachment has been uploaded. The visible gate and reproduction steps are described above; account-specific information is omitted.


Could you investigate a narrowly scoped compatibility fix for these two quiz paths? The workaround restores access while global protection stays enabled; the responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.

========================================================================

Other ad blocker

wBlock 3.2.1 (Safari content blocker that uses AdGuard filters and SafariConverterLib)

Annoyances — pop-ups, cookie warnings, etc.

Safari

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

[NSFW] https://txxx.me/videos/21126753/innocent-lesbians2/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

AdGuard Tracking Protection filter, AdGuard URL Tracking filter

AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter

### Add your comment and screenshots

1. Open any video page on txxx.me (the same happens on the home page after clicking a thumbnail), click "Enter" on the age notice, then click the player's play button. The click opens a popunder tab in the background. In two tries it went to `https://viiukuhe.com/dc/?blockID=420763&subID=0&page=https%3A%2F%2Ftxxx.me%2F&keywords=straight` and `https://www.javideos.com/?t=1000`.

Safari 27.2 on macOS 27.2, reproduced on 2026-10-13.

   Originally reported to wBlock in https://github.com/0xCUB3/wBlock/issues/977.

This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has been open for 3 days with no activity.
Unfortunately, our resources are limited and we can not always take the time to respond to requests about websites that are not popular enough. The issue will be closed if no further activity occurs.
Please note, that AdGuard Filters is an open-source project that is used by different content blockers and we welcome contributions. If you have some technical knowledge about how websites work, you are welcome to create a pull request following [these instructions](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.title: ad-contents.jp: Ponta kanji and idiom quiz anti-adblock gates (path-scoped workaround)

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Issue URL (AdGuard gets detected / website unavailable)

- https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/
- https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/

These are the Ponta PLAY kanji and four-character idiom quizzes. Account-specific query parameters have been omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, both pages displayed this gate instead of the quiz:

> This content cannot be accessed if AdBlock is enabled. Please disable AdBlock and try accessing it again.

I want to allow the advertisements on these particular games while keeping filtering enabled for unrelated websites.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose Pontaの漢字テスト or Pontaの四字熟語クイズ.
3. Observe the gate above before reaching the game.
4. Apply the exact site/path exception below and reopen the same game through the content list.
5. Compare the visible result with the baseline.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Kanji rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document`
- Idiom rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document`
- Kanji after fresh navigation: rules and quiz load; question/answer flow works.
- Idiom after fresh navigation to its actual route: introduction and start route load; the AdBlock gate is gone.
- Kanji game access is restored with the scoped exception. The responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.
- Idiom introduction/start access is restored. Completed idiom play or reward credit is not asserted.
- Global protection remains enabled; both exception rules listed above were saved and read back enabled.
- Specific responsible upstream filter: not isolated.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after these path-specific changes |

### Comparison and limitations

Global AdGuard protection was not disabled for a comparison. This comparison used the two path-specific exceptions listed above. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing have not been independently verified. The public filter names are the visible readbacks, not a complete private configuration export.

### Related report

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/52566 was resolved in March 2020 for /quiz/ponta/. This report concerns the currently reproduced /kanji/ponta/ and /yojijukugo/ponta/ routes.

### Screenshot description

The saved baseline captures show the quoted AdBlock gate on each game landing page. Fresh retest captures show accessible kanji quiz and actual idiom introduction/start routes. No screenshot attachment has been uploaded. The visible gate and reproduction steps are described above; account-specific information is omitted.


Could you investigate a narrowly scoped compatibility fix for these two quiz paths? The workaround restores access while global protection stays enabled; the responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.

========================================================================


---

### Consolidated retest — 14 October 2026 (JST)

Following the maintainer's consolidation request, this update covers #244150 and #244151 alongside the original quizzes.

**Configuration:** AdGuard Japanese filter enabled, version **2.0.77.44**, displayed update **13 October 2026, 23:35 JST**. All five temporary document exceptions were disabled and checked before testing. The later tests used original Japanese, Google Translate disabled and Japanese first in Chrome's languages. Chrome remained muted with its per-app audio-focus operation set to ignore; these audio settings were unchanged between the Paw comparisons.

**Quizzes:** both `ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/` and `ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/` reached the actual first question without their exceptions. The original access gates were absent. Fresh original-Japanese retests after disabling translation also reached **第1問** on both routes with protection enabled. Full quiz completion, advertisements and reward credit were not tested.

**Resort (#244151):** normal entry with protection enabled and its exception disabled reached the original-Japanese wall and contents menu; a promotional overlay could be dismissed. This verifies wall/menu access, not every individual game or advertisement.

**Paw (#244150), protection enabled:** after 18 remaining ordinary rounds without reload, index counter 0 → Next → `already.php` → **動画を見る** → `movie.php` remained **loading** at entry, about 30 seconds and about 65 seconds, without a playback/completion control.

**Paw protection-off baseline:** the disabled state was verified, then fresh normal entry through the same route showed **広告を見る！**. It opened an actual advertiser card with a video panel. At about 30 seconds, **報酬を獲得しました** and the close × appeared. Closing returned **おやつをゲットする！**, which opened `oyatsu_index.php` / **おやつモード**. The normal advertisement-completion and bonus-entry flow therefore worked with protection disabled under the otherwise unchanged stated settings. The responsible filter/module remains unisolated. Protection was restored and verified enabled afterward.

**English vocabulary:** a later original-Japanese retest with protection enabled again showed its blocking AdBlock modal. After verifying protection disabled, returning to the same browser page and using its official **ページを更新する**, the modal disappeared and **スタートする** was present on the normal introduction. Game completion, advertisement playback and reward credit were not tested; the responsible filter/module remains unisolated. Protection was restored and verified enabled. This separate route is tracked in [#222607](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/222607#issuecomment-6148987274).

**Verified rule cleanup:** permanently removed the now-unnecessary quiz and Resort exceptions:

```text
@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document
@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document
@@||ponta.content-lump.net/wall.php$document
```

Retained and re-enabled these two after the comparisons; their presence is not a claim that they reliably fix the failures:

```text
@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document
@@|https://ponta.abstractpainting.work/sp/sp-dog/movie.php$document
```

Please reopen this canonical issue to investigate the Paw bonus flow's actual enabled-versus-disabled difference. The quiz access gates and Resort wall/menu no longer require the tested exceptions for access; a narrow compatibility fix for the unresolved Paw flow is requested.


---

### Further verification of the retained exceptions — 14 October 2026 (JST)

The earlier cleanup confirmed that the two retained rules were enabled; that alone did not establish that either rule restored functionality. I am now testing their actual effect while AdGuard protection, the Japanese filter and the User rules master switch are enabled, with automatic translation disabled.

**Current configuration correction:** the current tests use **Chrome 155.0.8059.39**, **AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (42220003)** and **Android 16**, verified from installed package/system versions. The earlier Chrome 140 entry does not describe the current test environment. HTTPS filtering and Chrome's per-app HTTPS filtering are enabled; the certificate is installed and valid. Ad blocking, annoyance blocking, DNS protection and firewall are enabled; Tracking protection and Browsing security are disabled. DNS server is **Automatic**, DNS filters are enabled, and the enabled built-in **AdGuard DNS filter is 1.0.82.79**, updated **13 October 2026, 23:35 JST**. The displayed Peter Lowe, OISD small, HaGeZi Normal and AWAvenue DNS filters are disabled.

**English vocabulary:** with `@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document` enabled, a fresh normal entry still produced the original Japanese AdBlock modal. The page's official refresh control left it present. The original exception is therefore **ineffective in the tested configuration**. This route remains tracked separately in #222607.

**Priority candidate:** `@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document,important` was saved/enabled but also left the modal present after fresh normal entry and official refresh. Both the original Drill rule and this ineffective candidate were subsequently removed, and their absence was verified. This does not identify the responsible filter/module.

**DNS isolation, global protection left enabled:** turning off only DNS protection removed the Drill modal. I then restored DNS protection and disabled only the built-in **AdGuard DNS filter 1.0.82.79**, with all other displayed DNS lists disabled and the Automatic DNS server unchanged. Fresh normal entry again had no modal; **スタートする** opened the normal **開始する** confirmation. Actual Question 1, completed gameplay and rewards were not tested.

Restoring that DNS filter, keeping DNS protection enabled, closing/reopening Chrome and freshly entering the same game brought the original AdBlock modal back. Both temporary DNS changes were restored and checked. This enabled/disabled/re-enabled result narrows the Drill gate to the enabled **AdGuard DNS filter in this tested configuration**. The exact blocked hostname and rule have not been identified. Please advise a narrow DNS-compatible fix; the two web-document exceptions tested above did not solve it.

**Paw:** the prior protection-off baseline already unlocked the current period's snack-mode entitlement. Subsequent normal entry with the original Paw rule enabled now goes directly to `oyatsu_index.php`, skipping `movie.php`. Reaching that already-unlocked mode is **not evidence that the exception fixes the advertisement-loading failure**.

**Fresh Paw test availability/outcome:** the prior protection-off baseline had already unlocked the five-play bonus entitlement. I finished all five granted bonus plays normally, without reloads or direct reward requests; the bonus counter reached 0. Normal Next then led to `oyatsu_already.php` showing **参加済み** (already participated), rather than offering another advertisement. A fresh bonus-advertisement test is therefore unavailable in the current period, and the Paw exception's functional status remains **unverified**. A later eligible period is required for a valid test.

**Verified rule state:** the original and priority Drill rules are removed. The sole remaining exception is the enabled original Paw rule `@@|https://ponta.abstractpainting.work/sp/sp-dog/movie.php$document`, with the User rules master enabled; its functional effectiveness remains unverified. The three quiz/Resort rules previously removed remain removed. DNS protection and the built-in DNS filter are restored enabled. A genuine fresh bonus-advertisement test is still needed before deciding whether the Paw rule should be kept or removed.

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation

### Retest: English vocabulary game still blocked with the Japanese filter enabled

On 14 October 2026 (Japan time), I retested the English vocabulary game reported in my [earlier comment](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/222607#issuecomment-6137457805).

- **AdGuard Japanese filter:** enabled and verified in AdGuard for Android; version **2.0.77.44**, with the displayed update time **13 October 2026, 23:35 JST**.
- **Custom exceptions:** all five temporary path-specific document exceptions from my Ponta reports were disabled and their disabled state was checked, including `@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document`.
- **Protection:** global AdGuard protection remained enabled. This was not a protection-off comparison.
- **Navigation:** Ponta PLAY → Pontaドリル → ゲームスタート → コンテンツ一覧 → 英単語ゲーム, reaching `https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/top.php` through the normal authenticated flow. Account-specific query parameters are omitted.

The English game still displays a blocking dialog:

> 広告ブロック（アドブロック）を使用していますか？
>
> 広告ブロック（アドブロック）を無効にしてプレイいただきますようお願いします。

English: “Are you using an ad blocker? Please disable your ad blocker while playing.”

I used the dialog's refresh control once; the same dialog remained. Access to the English game is therefore still blocked under these retest conditions. Completed play, advertisement playback and reward credit have not been verified.

This is the **English vocabulary route**, separate from the kanji and idiom games in #244149. I have not isolated the responsible filter or module, so I am not attributing the failure to a particular list. Please investigate the narrowest compatibility fix that preserves filtering on unrelated websites.


---

### Later original-Japanese protection-on/off comparison — 14 October 2026 (JST)

The observations above describe the initial test. I subsequently disabled Chrome's Google Translate offer, put Japanese first in its preferred languages, and retested the same English vocabulary route with all five custom document exceptions still disabled. The Japanese filter remained enabled in the protection-on configuration.

- **Protection enabled:** the original Japanese AdBlock modal appeared, including the two Japanese sentences quoted above. This was a later untranslated reproduction, separate from the earlier translated refresh capture.
- **Protection disabled:** AdGuard's **Protection is disabled** state was verified. I returned to the same browser page and used its official **ページを更新する** (refresh page) control. The blocking modal then disappeared, and the normal game introduction with **スタートする** (start) was present. This was the same-page official-refresh comparison, not a claimed fresh entry or completed game.
- Chrome's mute/audio-focus settings and language/translation settings were unchanged between these comparisons. The responsible filter or module has not been isolated.

The observed difference is **modal present with protection enabled; absent after the official refresh with protection disabled**. Game completion, advertisement playback and reward credit were not tested in this comparison.

After this comparison, AdGuard protection was restored and **Protection is enabled** was verified. The existing English-game exception `@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document` was retained and re-enabled, with that state checked. Its presence is not a claim that it reliably fixes this dialog. The now-unnecessary kanji, idiom and Resort wall exceptions were permanently removed; the Paw exception was retained and re-enabled separately.

Please investigate a narrow compatibility fix for this English vocabulary route that keeps filtering on unrelated websites enabled.


---

### Retained rule's actual effect — 14 October 2026 (JST)

I separately tested whether the retained original exception restored access while protection stayed enabled. AdGuard protection, the Japanese filter, the User rules master switch and this rule were all enabled; Chrome translation was disabled:

**Current-version correction:** these tests use Chrome **155.0.8059.39**, AdGuard for Android **4.14.2 (42220003)** and Android **16**, verified from installed package/system versions. The earlier Chrome 140 entry does not describe this current environment.

```text
@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document
```

A fresh normal entry still displayed the original Japanese AdBlock modal, and the page's official **ページを更新する** control left it present. The original rule is therefore **ineffective in the tested configuration**. Its earlier retained/enabled state should not be interpreted as a successful workaround.

I also tested this same URL-prefix candidate, which changes priority without widening the URL pattern:

```text
@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document,important
```

The candidate was saved/enabled, but fresh normal entry and official refresh both still displayed the AdBlock modal. It is also **ineffective in the tested configuration**. Both the original and priority Drill exceptions were removed and their absence was verified.

**Verified module/DNS configuration:** HTTPS filtering is enabled, with a valid installed certificate; Chrome's per-app HTTPS filtering is enabled. Ad blocking, annoyance blocking, DNS protection and firewall are enabled; Tracking protection and Browsing security are disabled. DNS server is Automatic, DNS filters are enabled, and the enabled built-in AdGuard DNS filter is **1.0.82.79**, updated **13 October 2026, 23:35 JST**. The displayed Peter Lowe, OISD small, HaGeZi Normal and AWAvenue DNS filters are disabled.

**DNS isolation with global protection kept enabled:**

1. Temporarily turning off only DNS protection removed the AdBlock modal.
2. I restored DNS protection and disabled only the built-in **AdGuard DNS filter 1.0.82.79**. The other displayed DNS lists were disabled, and the Automatic DNS server was unchanged. Fresh normal entry had no modal; **スタートする** opened the normal **開始する** confirmation. Actual Question 1, completed gameplay, advertisement playback and reward credit were not tested.
3. I restored that filter, kept DNS protection enabled, closed/reopened Chrome and freshly entered the game again. The original Japanese AdBlock modal returned.

Both temporary DNS changes were restored and their enabled states checked. This enabled/disabled/re-enabled comparison narrows the gate to the enabled **AdGuard DNS filter in the tested configuration**; the exact blocked hostname and rule remain unknown.

The original and priority document exceptions have been removed. No effective replacement rule has been established. Please advise a narrow DNS-compatible fix that permits this game's required advertisement requests while preserving unrelated DNS protection.

The filter-level effect is now isolated under the stated configuration, but a particular hostname/rule has not been identified.

issue.title: ad-contents.jp: Ponta kanji and idiom quiz anti-adblock gates (path-scoped workaround)

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Issue URL (AdGuard gets detected / website unavailable)

- https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/
- https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/

These are the Ponta PLAY kanji and four-character idiom quizzes. Account-specific query parameters have been omitted.

### Description

On 13 October 2026, both pages displayed this gate instead of the quiz:

> This content cannot be accessed if AdBlock is enabled. Please disable AdBlock and try accessing it again.

I want to allow the advertisements on these particular games while keeping filtering enabled for unrelated websites.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open https://play.ponta.jp/content_list/index.html using an existing Ponta PLAY account.
2. Choose Pontaの漢字テスト or Pontaの四字熟語クイズ.
3. Observe the gate above before reaching the game.
4. Apply the exact site/path exception below and reopen the same game through the content list.
5. Compare the visible result with the baseline.

### Narrow exception and retest

- Kanji rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document`
- Idiom rule: `@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document`
- Kanji after fresh navigation: rules and quiz load; question/answer flow works.
- Idiom after fresh navigation to its actual route: introduction and start route load; the AdBlock gate is gone.
- Kanji game access is restored with the scoped exception. The responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.
- Idiom introduction/start access is restored. Completed idiom play or reward credit is not asserted.
- Global protection remains enabled; both exception rules listed above were saved and read back enabled.
- Specific responsible upstream filter: not isolated.

### System configuration

| Field | Observed value / verification status |
| --- | --- |
| AdGuard product / version | AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (build 42220003) |
| Android version | 16 |
| Browser / version | Chrome 140.0.7339.207 |
| Observed enabled public filters - partial list | AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, AdGuard Widgets filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances, AdGuard Social Media filter, AdGuard Russian filter |
| Observed regional filter note | Russian enabled; Japanese disabled |
| Filter update time | Not verified |
| Relevant HTTPS / DNS filtering | Not verified in supplied readback |
| Global AdGuard protection | Enabled before and after these path-specific changes |

### Comparison and limitations

Global AdGuard protection was not disabled for a comparison. This comparison used the two path-specific exceptions listed above. Product/browser currency and filter-update timing have not been independently verified. The public filter names are the visible readbacks, not a complete private configuration export.

### Related report

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/52566 was resolved in March 2020 for /quiz/ponta/. This report concerns the currently reproduced /kanji/ponta/ and /yojijukugo/ponta/ routes.

### Screenshot description

The saved baseline captures show the quoted AdBlock gate on each game landing page. Fresh retest captures show accessible kanji quiz and actual idiom introduction/start routes. No screenshot attachment has been uploaded. The visible gate and reproduction steps are described above; account-specific information is omitted.


Could you investigate a narrowly scoped compatibility fix for these two quiz paths? The workaround restores access while global protection stays enabled; the responsible upstream filter has not been isolated.

========================================================================


---

### Consolidated retest — 14 October 2026 (JST)

Following the maintainer's consolidation request, this update covers #244150 and #244151 alongside the original quizzes.

**Configuration:** AdGuard Japanese filter enabled, version **2.0.77.44**, displayed update **13 October 2026, 23:35 JST**. All five temporary document exceptions were disabled and checked before testing. The later tests used original Japanese, Google Translate disabled and Japanese first in Chrome's languages. Chrome remained muted with its per-app audio-focus operation set to ignore; these audio settings were unchanged between the Paw comparisons.

**Quizzes:** both `ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/` and `ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/` reached the actual first question without their exceptions. The original access gates were absent. Fresh original-Japanese retests after disabling translation also reached **第1問** on both routes with protection enabled. Full quiz completion, advertisements and reward credit were not tested.

**Resort (#244151):** normal entry with protection enabled and its exception disabled reached the original-Japanese wall and contents menu; a promotional overlay could be dismissed. This verifies wall/menu access, not every individual game or advertisement.

**Paw (#244150), protection enabled:** after 18 remaining ordinary rounds without reload, index counter 0 → Next → `already.php` → **動画を見る** → `movie.php` remained **loading** at entry, about 30 seconds and about 65 seconds, without a playback/completion control.

**Paw protection-off baseline:** the disabled state was verified, then fresh normal entry through the same route showed **広告を見る！**. It opened an actual advertiser card with a video panel. At about 30 seconds, **報酬を獲得しました** and the close × appeared. Closing returned **おやつをゲットする！**, which opened `oyatsu_index.php` / **おやつモード**. The normal advertisement-completion and bonus-entry flow therefore worked with protection disabled under the otherwise unchanged stated settings. The responsible filter/module remains unisolated. Protection was restored and verified enabled afterward.

**English vocabulary:** a later original-Japanese retest with protection enabled again showed its blocking AdBlock modal. After verifying protection disabled, returning to the same browser page and using its official **ページを更新する**, the modal disappeared and **スタートする** was present on the normal introduction. Game completion, advertisement playback and reward credit were not tested; the responsible filter/module remains unisolated. Protection was restored and verified enabled. This separate route is tracked in [#222607](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/222607#issuecomment-6148987274).

**Verified rule cleanup:** permanently removed the now-unnecessary quiz and Resort exceptions:

```text
@@|https://ad-contents.jp/kanji/ponta/$document
@@|https://ad-contents.jp/yojijukugo/ponta/$document
@@||ponta.content-lump.net/wall.php$document
```

Retained and re-enabled these two after the comparisons; their presence is not a claim that they reliably fix the failures:

```text
@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document
@@|https://ponta.abstractpainting.work/sp/sp-dog/movie.php$document
```

Please reopen this canonical issue to investigate the Paw bonus flow's actual enabled-versus-disabled difference. The quiz access gates and Resort wall/menu no longer require the tested exceptions for access; a narrow compatibility fix for the unresolved Paw flow is requested.


---

### Further verification of the retained exceptions — 14 October 2026 (JST)

The earlier cleanup confirmed that the two retained rules were enabled; that alone did not establish that either rule restored functionality. I am now testing their actual effect while AdGuard protection, the Japanese filter and the User rules master switch are enabled, with automatic translation disabled.

**Current configuration correction:** the current tests use **Chrome 155.0.8059.39**, **AdGuard for Android 4.14.2 (42220003)** and **Android 16**, verified from installed package/system versions. The earlier Chrome 140 entry does not describe the current test environment. HTTPS filtering and Chrome's per-app HTTPS filtering are enabled; the certificate is installed and valid. Ad blocking, annoyance blocking, DNS protection and firewall are enabled; Tracking protection and Browsing security are disabled. DNS server is **Automatic**, DNS filters are enabled, and the enabled built-in **AdGuard DNS filter is 1.0.82.79**, updated **13 October 2026, 23:35 JST**. The displayed Peter Lowe, OISD small, HaGeZi Normal and AWAvenue DNS filters are disabled.

**English vocabulary:** with `@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document` enabled, a fresh normal entry still produced the original Japanese AdBlock modal. The page's official refresh control left it present. The original exception is therefore **ineffective in the tested configuration**. This route remains tracked separately in #222607.

**Priority candidate:** `@@|https://pc-ponta.ib-game.jp/eitango/$document,important` was saved/enabled but also left the modal present after fresh normal entry and official refresh. Both the original Drill rule and this ineffective candidate were subsequently removed, and their absence was verified. This does not identify the responsible filter/module.

**DNS isolation, global protection left enabled:** turning off only DNS protection removed the Drill modal. I then restored DNS protection and disabled only the built-in **AdGuard DNS filter 1.0.82.79**, with all other displayed DNS lists disabled and the Automatic DNS server unchanged. Fresh normal entry again had no modal; **スタートする** opened the normal **開始する** confirmation. Actual Question 1, completed gameplay and rewards were not tested.

Restoring that DNS filter, keeping DNS protection enabled, closing/reopening Chrome and freshly entering the same game brought the original AdBlock modal back. Both temporary DNS changes were restored and checked. This enabled/disabled/re-enabled result narrows the Drill gate to the enabled **AdGuard DNS filter in this tested configuration**. The exact blocked hostname and rule have not been identified. Please advise a narrow DNS-compatible fix; the two web-document exceptions tested above did not solve it.

**Paw:** the prior protection-off baseline already unlocked the current period's snack-mode entitlement. Subsequent normal entry with the original Paw rule enabled now goes directly to `oyatsu_index.php`, skipping `movie.php`. Reaching that already-unlocked mode is **not evidence that the exception fixes the advertisement-loading failure**.

**Fresh Paw test availability/outcome:** the prior protection-off baseline had already unlocked the five-play bonus entitlement. I finished all five granted bonus plays normally, without reloads or direct reward requests; the bonus counter reached 0. Normal Next then led to `oyatsu_already.php` showing **参加済み** (already participated), rather than offering another advertisement. A fresh bonus-advertisement test is therefore unavailable in the current period, and the Paw exception's functional status remains **unverified**. A later eligible period is required for a valid test.

**Verified rule state:** the original and priority Drill rules are removed. The sole remaining exception is the enabled original Paw rule `@@|https://ponta.abstractpainting.work/sp/sp-dog/movie.php$document`, with the User rules master enabled; its functional effectiveness remains unverified. The three quiz/Resort rules previously removed remain removed. DNS protection and the built-in DNS filter are restored enabled. A genuine fresh bonus-advertisement test is still needed before deciding whether the Paw rule should be kept or removed.

comment.body:
I updated the issue body with the consolidated retests for #244150 and #244151. With the Japanese filter enabled and the custom exceptions disabled, both quiz access gates are gone and the Resort wall/menu is usable; those three exceptions are now removed.

The Paw bonus route still stayed loading through about 65 seconds with protection enabled. With protection disabled under otherwise unchanged language/audio settings, the normal ad completion and bonus-mode entry worked. The detailed comparison is in the updated body.

GitHub rejected my attempt to reopen this issue. Please reopen this canonical report to investigate the remaining Paw bonus-flow difference. The separate English vocabulary comparison is documented in [#222607](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/222607#issuecomment-6148987274).
